solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/battleships-in-a-board/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

419. Battleships in a Board

Given an m x n matrix board where each cell is a battleship 'X' or empty '.' , return the number of the battleships on board.

Battleships can only be placed horizontally or vertically on board. In other words, they can only be made of the shape 1 x k (1 row, k columns) or k x 1 (k rows, 1 column), where k can be of any size. At least one horizontal or vertical cell separates between two battleships (i.e., there are no adjacent battleships).

Example 1:

Input: board = [["X",".",".","X"],[".",".",".","X"],[".",".",".","X"]]
Output: 2

Example 2:

Input: board = [["."]]
Output: 0

Constraints:

    m == board.length
    n == board[i].length
    1 <= m, n <= 200
    board[i][j] is either '.' or 'X'.

Follow up: Could you do it in one-pass, using only O(1) extra memory and without modifying the values board?
"""


class Solution:
    def countBattleships(self, board: List[List[str]]) -> int:
        if not board or not board[0]:
            return 0
        m, n = len(board), len(board[0])
        count = 0
        for i in range(m):
            for j in range(n):
                if board[i][j] == "X":
                    # Check if it is the start of a battleship
                    if (i == 0 or board[i - 1][j] == ".") and (
                        j == 0 or board[i][j - 1] == "."
                    ):
                        count += 1
        return count


sol = Solution()

print(
    sol.countBattleships(
        [["X", ".", ".", "X"], [".", ".", ".", "X"], [".", ".", ".", "X"]]
    )
)  # 2

assert (
    sol.countBattleships(
        [["X", ".", ".", "X"], [".", ".", ".", "X"], [".", ".", ".", "X"]]
    )
    == 2
)
assert sol.countBattleships([["."]]) == 0

assert sol.countBattleships([["X"]]) == 1
assert sol.countBattleships([["."]]) == 0
assert sol.countBattleships([["X", "X", "X", "X"]]) == 1
assert sol.countBattleships([["X"], ["X"], ["X"], ["X"]]) == 1
assert sol.countBattleships([["X", ".", "X", ".", "X"]]) == 3
assert sol.countBattleships([["X"], ["."], ["X"], ["."], ["X"]]) == 3
assert sol.countBattleships([["."] * 200 for _ in range(200)]) == 0
assert sol.countBattleships([["X"] * 200 for _ in range(200)]) == 1
assert (
    sol.countBattleships(
        [["X" if (i + j) % 2 == 0 else "." for j in range(200)] for i in range(200)]
    )
    == 20000
)
assert sol.countBattleships([["X"] + ["."] * 199]) == 1
assert sol.countBattleships([["."] * 199 + ["X"]]) == 1
assert sol.countBattleships([["X"]] + [["."] * 200 for _ in range(199)]) == 1
